subject: Discovery recap + flex slot proposal for ClearWell deep dive
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Li <morgan@clearwell.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Discovery recap + flex slot proposal for ClearWell deep dive

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about ClearWell's latency SLAs and how your clinical search workloads spike during month-end indexing. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: heavy short-query traffic (p95 latency target 120ms), sensitive PHI needs (on-prem eval required), product team wants a technical deep dive that includes KV cache and quantization tradeoffs.
- Primary ask: 60–90 minute technical deep dive with infra + ML lead present + a short run through of a PoC plan.

Scheduling constraints you mentioned: US east mornings are best for engineering, but you have APAC stakeholders who prefer late afternoons their time. To make this simple, I sketched a "flex slots" approach — rotate a recurring 90-minute slot each week so each region gets at least one reasonable window over a three-week cycle. This avoids repeating the same UTC hour every week and keeps calendar conflicts minimal.

Attached: rotating-demo-windows.xlsx (simple rotating slots matrix) and a proposed-demo-agenda.pdf.

Would you and Jamie be available for any of these initial candidate slots next week? If none work, tell us two 90-minute windows you prefer and we'll take it off your hands.

Candidate week (all times shown in your local TZ when I invited; listed below as UTC for clarity):
- Option A: Tue 2025-06-17 15:00–16:30 UTC (US east friendly, EU overlap)
- Option B: Wed 2025-06-18 06:00–07:30 UTC (APAC-friendly; US east early)
- Option C: Thu 2025-06-19 12:00–13:30 UTC (middle ground)

If you confirm one, Ben will send the canonical calendar invite and include a dial-in + meeting runner doc. If you'd like us to reserve a recurring rotating slot pattern instead of a one-off, say the word and we'll propose the three-week rotation that bumps the slot forward by 6 hours each week.

Thanks — Camila

-- 
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Morgan Li <morgan@clearwell.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie O'Neill <jamie.oneill@clearwell.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 00:10:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + flex slot proposal for ClearWell deep dive

Thanks, Camila — helpful summary. Jamie and I compared calendars quickly. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Our ML infra lead (Sanjay) can join but only after 22:00 IST / 17:30 UTC on weekdays due to customer-facing hours in APAC.
- We will need an on-prem security checkpoint during the deep dive (SOC2 evidence + network requirements) — can your team bring a short slide for security/design?

From the candidate slots you listed, Option B (Wed 2025-06-18 06:00–07:30 UTC) is actually the best fit for our APAC folks. Option C is tolerable. Option A is hard for Sanjay.

If you can do Option B, please include the security/architect slide and Sanjay + our product manager on the invite. Otherwise we can propose two alternatives: Mon 2025-06-16 05:00–06:30 UTC or Fri 2025-06-20 23:00–00:30 UTC.

Appreciate the rotating idea — that could work well for ongoing syncs so EU/US/APAC get parity.

— Morgan
Head of AI, ClearWell Health
morgan@clearwell.ai

- Send a single invite for the one-off deep dive with required attendees and dial-in
